odia: ଝିଅ ହୋଇ ଯେବେ ଚୂଲିମୁଣ୍ଡକୁ ଯୋଗ୍ୟ ନ ହେଲା, ତା ଜନମଟା ବୃଥା
title: When a skill becomes a verdict
literal_meaning: If, being a girl, she is not fit for kitchen work, her birth is wasted.
explanation: The conditional turns a cooking expectation into a verdict on a girl’s entire life. The dictionary places this line under the act of cooking. Our critical reading questions that leap: a useful skill becomes a measure of human worth, imposed by gender. The source preserves the harsh judgment; it does not supply our rejection of it.
meaning_odia: ରୋଷେଇର ଯୋଗ୍ୟତାକୁ ଏଠି ଝିଅର ସମଗ୍ର ଜୀବନର ରାୟ କରାଯାଇଛି। ଅଭିଧାନ ପାକକର୍ମ ଅର୍ଥରେ ଏହି କଥା ଦିଏ। ଆମ ସମାଲୋଚନାତ୍ମକ ପଢ଼ା ସେହି ଡେଇଁବାକୁ ପଚାରେ: ଗୋଟିଏ ଦରକାରୀ କୌଶଳ କିପରି ଲିଙ୍ଗ ଆଧାରରେ ମଣିଷର ମୂଲ୍ୟ ମାପେ? କଠୋର ରାୟଟି ଉତ୍ସରେ ଅଛି; ତାହାକୁ ପ୍ରଶ୍ନ କରିବା ଆମର ପଢ଼ା।
english_summary: Our critical reading questions measuring a girl’s worth by cooking ability.
odia_summary: ରୋଷେଇରେ ଝିଅର ମୂଲ୍ୟ ମାପିବାକୁ ଆମ ପଢ଼ା ପଚାରେ।
usage_example: Original imagined example: During a discussion of household expectations, a reader quotes the line. Another replies that everyone can learn useful kitchen skills, while nobody’s life becomes worthless for lacking one. They discuss sharing the work instead of testing only daughters. This is an invented critical conversation, not evidence of a traditional reply.
cultural_context: Two related quotations occur in this one headword. They document gendered language, not the beliefs of every family or a named community. No origin date or endorsement is supplied.
